modalities.visible: Named source fields occur directly in the stage ingress schema.
modalities.derived_only: Exactly one named pure projection is allowlisted; its algorithm ID, source hashes, and output hash are recorded, and raw source fields are absent from stage ingress.
modalities.hidden: A privileged harness may use the item only for the named routing action; every item field is absent from serialized stage ingress, egress, model bytes, scores, errors, timing class, and public IDs.
modalities.forbidden: Static dependency checks and runtime taint mutation must prove the item cannot be read or influence any stage choice, bytes, debit, status, timing class, or output. Any influence is RUN_INVALID.
